original_bug_mechanism: Reader delivery can occur just after the asynchronous command wait budget expires.
synthetic_bug_mechanism: The terminal-response pattern accepts only a single digit in an error code, so a complete Error 12 line is mistaken for unfinished output.
distinctness: The original upstream fix is retained. The terminal-response pattern accepts only a single digit in an error code, so a complete Error 12 line is mistaken for unfinished output.
oracle: A delayed Error 12: LinkMarginLow must return as the terminal response, in order, without ExpectLineTimeoutError.
realism: Dropping a regex quantifier silently restricts valid protocol values while preserving ordinary Done and single-digit errors.
test_changes: Minimal additions to the existing regression suite; original tests and assertions preserved.
